Starmap is a comprehensive AI model catalog system that provides
information about AI models, their capabilities, and providers.

It includes an embedded catalog of models that can be accessed offline,
as well as the ability to fetch live model information from provider APIs
when API keys are configured.

Usage:
  starmap [command]

Setup Commands:
  auth        Cloud provider authentication helpers
  deps        Check and install external dependencies
  migrate     Migrate local Starmap storage layouts

Catalog Commands:
  authors     List AI model authors
  models      Manage AI models
  providers   Manage AI providers and test credentials
  update      Synchronize catalog with the default or selected sources

Server Commands:
  serve       Start the REST API server

Development Commands:
  embed       Explore embedded filesystem
  validate    Validate catalog structure

Additional Commands:
  completion  Manage shell completions
  help        Help about any command
  version     Show version information

Flags:
      --cache-dir string                        absolute disposable cache root (STARMAP_CACHE_DIR)
      --catalog-acquisition-enabled string      Enables automatic provider acquisition. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_ACQUISITION_ENABLED
      --catalog-acquisition-interval string     Sets the acquisition period. Zero permits one startup pass when automatic acquisition is on. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_ACQUISITION_INTERVAL
      --catalog-coalesce-window string          Bounds the wait before completed provider observations publish. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_COALESCE_WINDOW
      --catalog-refresh-timeout string          Limits the time for one refresh. Zero adds no cap. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_REFRESH_TIMEOUT
      --catalog-source string                   Selects the upstream catalog source. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE
      --catalog-source-aliases string           Names other identities of this runtime for source cycle detection. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_ALIASES
      --catalog-source-api-key string           Authenticates transport to the selected catalog source. It is separate from provider credentials. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_API_KEY
      --catalog-source-channel string           Names the branch that holds the catalog channel document. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_CHANNEL
      --catalog-source-max-age string           Sets the source freshness warning threshold. Zero keeps the default channel freshness thresholds. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_MAX_AGE
      --catalog-source-max-hops string          Limits the accepted source chain length. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_MAX_HOPS
      --catalog-source-poll-interval string     Sets the period between automatic source checks. Zero disables periodic checks. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
      --catalog-source-repository string        Names the GitHub repository that publishes the catalog channel. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_REPOSITORY
      --catalog-source-signer-workflow string   Pins the accepted build provenance workflow. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_SIGNER_WORKFLOW
      --catalog-source-startup-policy string    Selects catalog availability before the first upstream reply. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_STARTUP_POLICY
      --catalog-source-token string             Authenticates transport to the selected catalog source. It is separate from provider credentials. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_TOKEN
      --catalog-source-url string               Names the Starmap endpoint or catalog file. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_SOURCE_URL
      --catalog-startup-spread string           Spreads cold automatic work across a stable time window. Zero disables the spread. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_STARTUP_SPREAD
      --catalog-store-path string               catalog store path, relative to the configuration root unless absolute (STARMAP_CATALOG_STORE_PATH)
      --catalog-transfer-idle-timeout string    Bounds a transfer that makes no progress. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_TRANSFER_IDLE_TIMEOUT
      --catalog-transfer-max-duration string    Bounds one finite HTTP body transfer. It does not bound an open event stream. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_TRANSFER_MAX_DURATION
      --catalog-workspace-path string           Names the reviewed operator catalog input. Environment: STARMAP_CATALOG_WORKSPACE_PATH
      --config string                           configuration file (default is config.yaml under the selected configuration root)
      --config-dir string                       absolute configuration root (STARMAP_CONFIG_DIR)
      --data-dir string                         absolute durable data root (STARMAP_DATA_DIR)
      --deployment-id string                    persistent deployment identity (default: local) (STARMAP_DEPLOYMENT_ID)
      --env-file stringArray                    load an explicit dotenv file (repeat in increasing precedence)
  -h, --help                                    help for starmap
      --home string                             absolute parent for configuration, data, state, and cache (STARMAP_HOME)
      --instance-id string                      portable instance name for one process (default: default) (STARMAP_INSTANCE_ID)
      --log-level string                        log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error (overrides -v/-q)
      --no-color                                disable colored output
  -o, --output string                           output format: table, json, yaml, wide
  -q, --quiet                                   minimal output (shortcut for --log-level=warn)
      --scheduler-identity string               Sets a stable identity for this runtime instance. Environment: STARMAP_SCHEDULER_IDENTITY
      --state-dir string                        Names the runtime state directory for this process. Environment: STARMAP_STATE_DIR
      --state-root string                       absolute process state root (STARMAP_STATE_ROOT)
  -v, --verbose                                 verbose output (shortcut for --log-level=debug)
      --version                                 version for starmap

Use "starmap [command] --help" for more information about a command.
